knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Quotes are compared on the same scope, and the excluded task is quoted or stated before comparison and approval.
A licence is recorded as held only after the licence or registration and class are checked.
The lesson says to route each quote to the owner for approval and to book work only after written approval is received.

practicalCriteria: Given three simulated quotes, the worker compares them on the same scope and identifies any exclusion before routing to approval.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Quote comparison sheet for the simulated job
stopWorkCriteria: A contractor is booked before written owner approval
